text:
Type: natural jute area rug
Use: anchoring a seating or dining area; living room, dining room, bedroom
Style: coastal, bohemian, Scandinavian
Materials: chunky handwoven jute flatweave
Colors: warm natural tan, golden brown, light flecks
Shape: rectangular, flat, coarse chunky basket-weave texture with visible fibre loops, plain edges, large and relaxed
Feel: earthy, natural, relaxed, warm
Goes with: white walls, light wood, rattan, linen and plants; coastal, bohemian or Japandi rooms

product.name: LOHALS
product.description: Jute is a durable and recyclable material with natural colour variations.
